https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/33877#discussion_r1728815318 explicitly asked to remove the conditionalization, which is being added back here
I think conditionalizing this here makes more sense, also corresponding to the `RESTART_MODE_DIRECT` branch above.
I don't think it's actually necessary? E.g. we don't add such comments for fd_cloexec, because the name already clearly encodes the meaning/action here.

yeah, i'd agree with @YHNdnzj. if the function name makes clear enough what the parameter is no need to add the extra config. hence, yes, if we have a setter call then i think it's pretty clear that first arg is the object to set the thing on, and 2nd arg is the value to set that thing to.
